vc_checking.summary: All 36 cleaned manual obligations are semantically proofable. No target requires changing annotation, generated statements, or seed case_lib. Hard obligations are live-byte-to-initialized-slice bridges, bounded sublist algebra, and LogicalState preservation after consuming a positive FIFO prefix.
